description: Percentile rank of a digital SAT total score (400-1600) or section score (200-800, Reading and Writing or Math), from the College Board percentile tables: the user group percentile (actual SAT takers, past three graduating classes) and the nationally representative percentile (all US 11th and 12th graders). Also compares the score with the class of 2026 national mean (1,954,833 test takers) and score band.

score.description: SAT score in steps of 10, for example 1350 for a total or 680 for a section.

section.description: total (400-1600), rw (Reading and Writing, 200-800) or math (200-800). Default total.

name: get_sat_percentile
title: Get SAT percentile
